text:
julia: Kevin asked for SOC2 evidence: (1) RBAC approval flow for any prod service-account created since 2025-10-01, (2) KMS Decrypt event samples tied to model keys, (3) short CVE-2025-1122 triage summary. Can someone own packaging? :hand:

kevin_auditor: For RBAC we need PR or ticket proof + k8s audit snippet showing the create and approver. For KMS: raw CloudTrail Decrypt JSON (eventTime, requestParameters.keyId, userIdentity.principalId). For CVE: 1-paragraph summary + timeline with links. Bundle as zip with manifest.json. Deadline Tue EOD.

omar: I'll take RBAC. Plan: export infra PR diffs, JIRA screenshots, and a CSV mapping SA -> requester -> approver. I'll also include a short policy excerpt on separation-of-duties.

julia: I'll pull KMS CloudTrail samples and Splunk matches, redact IPs, keep principalId/keyId. Command: aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2025-10-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z --max-results 100 > decrypt.json

omar: Good. For packaging I'll put artifacts under s3://redwood-evidence/tmp/1799987654/ and include exceptions.txt if we redact more than IPs.

kevin_auditor: That workflow is fine. Please include at least three random SA examples for RBAC verification. Also include keypolicy.md (rotation cadence + owners).

julia: Uploading decrypt-sample.json and splunk-records.csv now. Will DM presigned link when bundle is ready.

evidence-bot: Evidence bundle job queued. Job id ev-1799987654. ETA 40m.

omar: Pushed RBAC zip and mapping CSV to s3. Filed manifest draft pointing artifacts to SOC2 controls.

kevin_auditor: Thanks — send presigned URL when ready. We'll review and follow up if we need deeper artifacts.

julia: Will do. Closing loop once ops confirms bundle creation. :white_check_mark:
